agent_vs_you: The agent's chain (generate footage, then a code text-overlay with the exact words and timing) is right, and the overlay text itself came out exact. The decisive mistake was inside the footage prompt: to leave room it wrote 'clear space at bottom left for a lower third', and the video model took 'lower third' literally and painted a TV-style lower third (a circular 'ES' monogram and a teal banner of garbled words) at bottom left from about 0.5 s to the end; 'no text or signage' did not undo it. A generation prompt should describe only the scene and composition, never the graphics that will be added later. Second, the agent asked text-overlay for 'align: left', but the caption card is always centred horizontally, so the real caption landed bottom-centre on top of the fake banner; the catalogue does not say horizontal placement is impossible, so the agent could not know.

your_plan.say: I'll make clean 7-second widescreen garden footage of a fictional woman turning toward the camera with a smile, then add 'Maya Chen' over 'Community Gardener' in white on a dark box at the bottom left from second 1 to the end. Silent.

params.prompt_or_change: Natural documentary photograph, 16:9: a friendly woman in her thirties standing among raised vegetable beds and bean trellises in a sunny community garden, turned three-quarters away from the camera, a gentle smile, standing right of centre in a medium shot, leafy beds and soft green background filling the left half of the frame. Soft daylight. Plain photograph with nothing overlaid.

steps.why: A clean first frame with her on the right and an uncluttered lower left; it costs 5 credits and keeps the composition under control.

params.prompt_or_change: Steady locked-off camera. The woman slowly turns her head and shoulders slightly toward the camera and breaks into a warm, natural smile; a light breeze moves the leaves. Everything else stays as in the picture.

steps.why: The motion asked for, starting from a frame that has no graphics in it; the clip's invented sound is dropped by default.

params.extra: at: bottom; align: left; from: 1; to: 7

steps.why: Code renders the two exact lines (quoted strings become the two lines) in white on a dark box, from 1 s to the end; bottom-left needs the align fix below.

fix: 1) Planner rule: a generation prompt describes the scene only; never name the overlay ('lower third', 'title', 'caption', 'space for text') in it, because video and image models draw what they are told about. Say 'leave the lower left uncluttered' in plain composition terms instead. 2) Harness: text-overlay/captionCard accepts align: left|center|right (left = 5% margin, left-aligned lines) and the catalogue line says so; today 'align: left' is silently ignored and every card is centred. 3) Run a check for unwanted text on generated footage (frame + check) before overlaying.
evidence: garden_clip.mp4 (858x480, 7.29 s): the woman smiles and turns toward the camera in a garden with trellises; from ~0.5 s to the end the bottom-left 200x80 region holds a model-drawn lower third: a circular 'ES' monogram and a dark teal banner reading 'RagMirinsnlen / Vagon Trotents', fading to the monogram at the end. maya_garden_final.mp4: our card reads exactly 'Maya Chen' over 'Community Gardener', white on a translucent dark box, absent at 0.5 s and present from 1 s, but centred at the bottom (captionCard computes bx=(W-bw)/2), overlapping the fake banner. Both files have a video stream only (silent). The footage prompt contained 'clear space at bottom left for a lower third'.
